rules.statement: An oral account stated does not fall under section 8 of the Prescription Ordinance, No. 22 of 1871, unless there were mutual dealings and transactions between parties.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where there have been mutual dealings and mutual transactions and accounts between parties and it is averred that accounts between them were verbally stated and settled, that constitutes an account stated which would bring the case within the provisions of section 8. But where, as here, it is merely a one-sided account that is said to have been stated and acknowledged to have been correct and where there have been no such mutual dealings, then it would seem to be well settled law in Ceylon that in the absence of a written settlement a claim which in substance is a claim for goods sold and delivered is barred by the provisions of section 9 and cannot be taken outside the bar imposed by that section except by some written acknowledgment."
